records.why: Carries the virtualised-rows clause plus fixed row height by density token and persisted column state.
Spreadsheet batch-entry guidance (F2/F4 editors, paste, totals row) for a grid declared IsReadOnly=True; adds per-row cost on a scroll-cost complaint.
The performance record c3 identified as the headline miss; windowed rendering with stable row heights is the fix for 3,000-row jank.
The N-rows-must-not-be-N-Tab-stops rule drove the change the c3 implementer actually shipped.

change_vs_c3: better - web-virtualize-long-lists, the record c3 named as the single biggest retrieval miss, is now in the bundle; both records the implementer used are retained and two weak records (data-exceptions-first, table-column-disambiguation) are gone, though comp-data-entry-grid and the missing perf.layout_shift persist.
